content_text: No shame, cinema Is so full of great works that it’s impossible to know everything. I am in your same situation and i discovered great movies thanks to the forum and the podcast. For example thanks to Roger i discovered one of the best movie i’ve seen, The Silence of The Sea (the original clandestine movie by Melville). 3 people closed in a room and only one talks. I would’ve never watched it on these premises, but Roger quoted it, i trusted his knowledge and i discovered an absolute masterpiece.
